kjv: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope. My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.

lines.say: It's Christmas Eve. Waiting on something tonight? This is for you.
I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope. My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning:
lines.big: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope. My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning:

lines.say: I say, more than they that watch for the morning. Psalm one thirty, verses five and six.
lines.big: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.

lines.say: The watchmen waited all night for morning. Morning always came. So did he.
lines.big: The watchmen waited all night for morning. Morning always came. So did he.

lines.say: Lord, I'm waiting on you tonight. Thank you for keeping every promise. In Jesus' name, amen.
